customManagers.description: Bump the team-management Harbor image tags to the latest platform-idp release. Harbor (harbor.127.0.0.1.sslip.io) is a local, self-signed registry Renovate can't reach, so versions are resolved from the PUBLIC platform-idp git tags (the single unified vX.Y.Z release that builds all teams-* images) and rewritten into the Harbor image line.

packageRules.description: All three teams-* images share the unified version, so group them into one PR and auto-merge it. This is the only manager enabled, so every Renovate PR in this repo is this group — auto-merging it removes the manual-merge toil after each platform-idp release. With no required status checks on this repo, Renovate merges as soon as the PR is opened; platformAutomerge lets it use GitHub's native auto-merge if branch protection is added later.
